personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 6 Glass / Luxe colors and typography
personality_one_liner: A professional, cinematic production suite that balances Apple-native ease of use with the premium, restrained mood of a film set.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use for sidebar background in iPad split layout
Use for bottom toolbars and floating action buttons
Use on hero cards representing film projects with a brand-tinted overlay
dont's: Do not blur form fields or the screenplay text editor
Do not blur small data cards like lens calculations
Do not apply blur without a tinted base underneath

screens.name: Dashboard Progetti
screens.purpose: A cinematic home screen to browse and create film projects (film, corto, serie, clip).

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with 'Caricamento progetti...' text
states.empty: Empty clapperboard illustration with 'Nessun progetto trovato. Crea il tuo primo capolavoro.' and a primary CTA 'Nuovo Progetto'

screens.layout: Grid layout using 2-column or 3-column wrap for projects on iPad. Each project card features a cinematic background image, a vertical gradient scrim (top to bottom fade), and the project title in Fraunces display font.

screens.name: Project Hub & Screenplay Editor
screens.purpose: A master-detail split screen for iPad to manage all pre-production phases and draft standard-format scripts.

states.loading: Skeleton rows in the sidebar and a spinner in the main content area
states.empty: N/A - the hub always shows the tools index by default
states.error: Connection error state with 'Ricarica hub' button

screens.layout: Split-screen layout (Master-Detail). Sidebar on the left containing expandable categories (Sviluppo, Pre-produzione, Set, Post-produzione). Main area on the right shows the active tool. For the 'Sceneggiatura' tool, use a distraction-free white/dark canvas using Courier or Courier Prime font specifically for the script content to adhere to industry standards, with a bottom sticky formatting toolbar.

screens.name: Storyboard & Shotlist
screens.purpose: A visual workspace to plan shots and draw storyboards with Apple Pencil.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty frame with 'Aggiungi la tua prima scena o inquadratura.'

screens.layout: Master-Detail layout. Left panel: scrollable thumbnail strip (Shotlist) with draggable rows for scenes. Right panel: a large canvas area for Apple Pencil drawing, with a tool palette (pen, eraser, color) floating over the canvas with glassmorphism.

screens.name: Set Tools (Digital Slate & Trackers)
screens.purpose: High-density utility command center for on-set execution (Lens calc, Clapperboard, Time tracker, Sun path).
screens.layout: Grid-based modular dashboard. Stacked modules and segmented controls. The clapperboard (Slate) should be a large, full-bleed interactive card that fills the screen when tapped, displaying timecode, scene, and take in large mono typography.

project_hero_placeholder.alt: Film production set behind the scenes

empty_clapperboard.alt: Classic film clapperboard on a green surface

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for iPad using responsive split-screen layouts (Master-Detail). Left sidebar for navigation and item lists, right panel for deep work (Screenplay, Storyboard canvas).
Implement both Light ('Chiaro e pulito') and Dark ('Scuro cinematografico') themes as requested by the user, providing a toggle in the UI. Dark theme is the default cinematic look.

For the 'Screenplay Editor' component ONLY, override the text font to Courier Prime or a standard Courier monospaced font to maintain industry-standard script formatting (Scene Heading, Action, Character, Dialogue). Use the 'Geist' font for the rest of the application UI.
Comply with NO BLUE rule strictly. Use Antique Gold (`#D4AF37`) as the primary brand color for selected states, CTAs, and accents.
Integrate glassmorphism (expo-glass-effect or expo-blur) extensively on sidebars, sticky headers, and floating toolbars to achieve the 'Luxe' cinematic feel.
Ensure 'Storyboard' supports touch/Apple Pencil interactions seamlessly on the drawing canvas area without triggering unintended scroll events.
Any text displayed on image backgrounds (like project cards) MUST use a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> 20% surfaceInverse -> 70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text legibility.
Implement high-density utility controls (segmented controls, stacked metrics) for the 'Set Tools' section to ensure it feels like a professional on-set command center.
